_GEOMETRY_SIZES: Final[tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]] = (
    (80, 24),
    (100, 28),
    (80, 40),
    (140, 40),
)
_GEOMETRY_IDS: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = ("80x24", "100x28", "80x40", "140x40")
_RAIL_SIZES: Final[tuple[tuple[int, int, bool], ...]] = (
    (80, 24, False),
    (100, 28, False),
    (140, 40, True),
)
_RAIL_IDS: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = ("ultra-narrow", "narrow", "wide")
_MIN_READING_ROWS: Final[int] = 6
_GROWTH_ENTRY_COUNT: Final[int] = 4
_GROWTH_SIZE: Final[tuple[int, int]] = (100, 40)
_COMPLETE_SIZE: Final[tuple[int, int]] = (140, 40)
_REGION_COMPOSERS: Final[tuple[object, ...]] = (
    compose_progress_region,
    compose_reading_region,
    compose_tools_region,
)
_REGION_IDS: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = ("#run-progress", "#run-reading", "#run-tools")


class TestRunScreenThreeRegionGeometry:
    """Fixed progress and tools strips around a flexible reading region."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(("width", "height"), _GEOMETRY_SIZES, ids=_GEOMETRY_IDS)
    async def test_regions_stack_without_overlap(
        self,
        run_geometry_probe: RunGeometryProbe,
        width: int,
        height: int,
    ) -> None:
        geometry = await run_geometry_probe.at(width, height)

        assert geometry.progress.visible, (
            f"progress strip must be mounted and visible at {width}x{height}"
        )
        assert geometry.reading.visible, (
            f"reading region must be mounted and visible at {width}x{height}"
        )
        assert geometry.tools.visible, (
            f"tools strip must be mounted and visible at {width}x{height}"
        )
        assert geometry.reading.height > 0, (
            f"reading region must keep a positive height at {width}x{height}"
        )

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(("width", "height"), _GEOMETRY_SIZES, ids=_GEOMETRY_IDS)
    async def test_fixed_strips_keep_their_declared_heights(
        self,
        run_geometry_probe: RunGeometryProbe,
        width: int,
        height: int,
    ) -> None:
        geometry = await run_geometry_probe.at(width, height)

        assert geometry.progress.height == PROGRESS_ROWS, (
            f"progress strip must occupy exactly {PROGRESS_ROWS} rows at "
            f"{width}x{height}, got {geometry.progress.height}"
        )
        assert geometry.tools.height == TOOLS_ROWS, (
            f"tools strip must occupy exactly {TOOLS_ROWS} rows at "
            f"{width}x{height}, got {geometry.tools.height}"
        )

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(("width", "height"), _GEOMETRY_SIZES, ids=_GEOMETRY_IDS)
    async def test_regions_stay_adjacent_and_ordered(
        self,
        run_geometry_probe: RunGeometryProbe,
        width: int,
        height: int,
    ) -> None:
        geometry = await run_geometry_probe.at(width, height)
        progress_bottom = geometry.progress.y + geometry.progress.height
        reading_bottom = geometry.reading.y + geometry.reading.height

        assert progress_bottom <= geometry.reading.y, (
            f"progress strip must end before the reading starts at {width}x{height}: "
            f"progress bottom {progress_bottom} vs reading top {geometry.reading.y}"
        )
        assert reading_bottom <= geometry.tools.y, (
            f"reading must end before the tools strip starts at {width}x{height}: "
            f"reading bottom {reading_bottom} vs tools top {geometry.tools.y}"
        )

    async def test_reading_keeps_six_content_rows_at_80x24(
        self,
        run_geometry_probe: RunGeometryProbe,
    ) -> None:
        geometry = await run_geometry_probe.at(80, 24)

        assert geometry.reading_content_rows >= _MIN_READING_ROWS, (
            f"80x24 must keep at least {_MIN_READING_ROWS} content rows in the "
            f"reading region, got {geometry.reading_content_rows}"
        )


async def test_composed_regions_mount_at_their_declared_ids(
    run_geometry_probe: RunGeometryProbe,
) -> None:
    """The three region composers mount the panels the screen always shows."""
    async with run_geometry_probe.session(80, 24) as (app, _pilot):
        screen = app.screen
        mounted = {
            selector: screen.query_one(selector)
            for selector in _REGION_IDS
        }
        narrative = screen.query_one("#agent-trace")

    assert len(_REGION_COMPOSERS) == len(_REGION_IDS), (
        "each composed Run region needs a declared widget ID"
    )
    for selector, widget in mounted.items():
        assert widget.display, f"{selector} must be visible on a fresh Run screen"
    assert narrative.display, "the activity narrative must be the default reading"


async def test_narrative_growth_leaves_strip_coordinates_unchanged(
    run_geometry_probe: RunGeometryProbe,
) -> None:
    """Growing the narrative must not move either fixed strip."""
    async with run_geometry_probe.session(*_GROWTH_SIZE) as (app, pilot):
        before = run_geometry_probe.measure_in(app)
        stored_entries = grow_narrative(app, _GROWTH_ENTRY_COUNT)
        await pilot.pause()
        after = run_geometry_probe.measure_in(app)
        rendered_entries = rendered_entry_count(app)

    assert stored_entries == _GROWTH_ENTRY_COUNT, (
        f"the store must retain every appended message, got {stored_entries}"
    )
    assert rendered_entries == stored_entries, (
        f"the narrative must render every retained message, got {rendered_entries} "
        f"of {stored_entries}"
    )
    assert after.progress == before.progress, (
        f"progress strip moved as the narrative grew: {before.progress} -> "
        f"{after.progress}"
    )
    assert after.tools == before.tools, (
        f"tools strip moved as the narrative grew: {before.tools} -> {after.tools}"
    )
    assert after.reading == before.reading, (
        f"reading region bounds changed as its content grew: {before.reading} -> "
        f"{after.reading}"
    )
    assert after.narrative_rows == before.narrative_rows, (
        f"narrative surface rows changed as its content grew: "
        f"{before.narrative_rows} -> {after.narrative_rows}"
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("width", "height", "rail_visible"),
    _RAIL_SIZES,
    ids=_RAIL_IDS,
)
async def test_left_rail_visibility_follows_width(
    run_geometry_probe: RunGeometryProbe,
    width: int,
    height: int,
    rail_visible: bool,
) -> None:
    """The rail hides at narrow widths while the three regions stay put."""
    async with run_geometry_probe.session(width, height) as (app, _pilot):
        rail = app.screen.query_one("#left-rail")
        header = app.screen.query_one("#run-header")
        geometry = run_geometry_probe.measure_in(app)
        rail_displayed = bool(rail.display)
        header_displayed = bool(header.display)
        header_top = header.region.y
        header_bottom = header.region.y + header.region.height

    assert rail_displayed is rail_visible, (
        f"left rail visibility must be {rail_visible} at {width}x{height}"
    )
    assert geometry.progress.visible, (
        f"progress strip must stay visible at {width}x{height}"
    )
    assert geometry.reading.visible, (
        f"reading region must stay visible at {width}x{height}"
    )
    assert geometry.tools.visible, f"tools strip must stay visible at {width}x{height}"
    assert header_displayed, (
        f"page/count header must stay visible in the top strip at {width}x{height}"
    )
    assert geometry.progress.y <= header_top, (
        f"page/count header must sit inside the top progress strip at "
        f"{width}x{height}: header top {header_top} vs progress top "
        f"{geometry.progress.y}"
    )
    progress_bottom = geometry.progress.y + geometry.progress.height
    assert header_bottom <= progress_bottom, (
        f"page/count header must not spill out of the top progress strip at "
        f"{width}x{height}: header bottom {header_bottom} vs progress bottom "
        f"{progress_bottom}"
    )


async def test_completion_summary_stays_inside_progress_strip(
    run_geometry_probe: RunGeometryProbe,
) -> None:
    """The relocated terminal summary must not overlap the reading region."""
    layout: CompletionLayout = await measure_completion_layout(
        run_geometry_probe, _COMPLETE_SIZE
    )
    geometry: RunGeometry = layout.geometry
    progress_bottom = geometry.progress.y + geometry.progress.height

    assert layout.displayed, "terminal projection must reveal the completion summary"
    assert geometry.progress.y <= layout.top, (
        f"completion summary must start inside the progress strip: summary top "
        f"{layout.top} vs progress top {geometry.progress.y}"
    )
    assert layout.bottom <= progress_bottom, (
        f"completion summary must stay inside the progress strip instead of "
        f"overlapping the reading region: summary bottom {layout.bottom} vs "
        f"progress bottom {progress_bottom}"
    )
    assert len(layout.visible_lines) == len(layout.summary_lines), (
        f"every rendered summary line must fit the progress strip: "
        f"{len(layout.visible_lines)} visible of {len(layout.summary_lines)} rendered"
    )


def test_run_screen_uses_the_composed_regions() -> None:
    """The Run screen composes exactly the three regions these tests measure."""
    composed = {composer.__name__ for composer in _REGION_COMPOSERS}

    assert composed == {
        "compose_progress_region",
        "compose_reading_region",
        "compose_tools_region",
    }, f"unexpected region composers: {sorted(composed)}"
    assert RunScreen is not None, "the Run screen must own the composed regions"

"""Typed request bag for ``GET /api/opportunities`` list calls.

Bundles paging plus every server-side filter param into one frozen
value so :meth:`OpportunitiesClient.list` keeps a single-parameter
seam (≤4-param budget) while the screen layer composes filters
declaratively. Field names mirror the route's query-param contract
(:class:`cloud.routers.opportunities._deps._ListQueryParams`).
"""

@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class OpportunityListQuery:
    """Paging + filter inputs for one opportunities list request.

    Attributes:
        limit: Page size (server clamps to its max).
        offset: Zero-based index into the ranked result set.
        state: Single-state whitelist, or ``None`` for all states.
        q: Free-text query AND-matched against company/title/location.
        country: ISO country code; unknown-country rows are hidden.
        remote_mode: Confirmed remote mode (``remote``/``hybrid``/``onsite``).
        salary_min: Compensation floor compared to the posting's range top.
        posted_after_days: Recency window relative to request time.
        hide_stale: Drop rows whose derived liveness is stale/expired.
        hide_dismissed: Drop dismissed rows when no explicit state is selected.
    """

    limit: int
    offset: int = 0
    state: str | None = None
    q: str | None = None
    country: str | None = None
    remote_mode: str | None = None
    salary_min: float | None = None
    posted_after_days: int | None = None
    hide_stale: bool = False
    hide_dismissed: bool = False
    include_descriptions: bool = False
    states: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    country_isos: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    include_unknown_country: bool = False
    include_dismissed: bool | None = None
    livenesses: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    sources: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    ats_types: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    companies: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    company_group_keys: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    remote_modes: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    regions: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    employment_types: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    commitments: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    experiences: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    departments: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    teams: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    archetypes: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    languages: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    salary_currencies: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    salary_periods: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    follow_up_statuses: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    linked_run_statuses: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    application_limit_statuses: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    application_limit_rule_kinds: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    application_limit_scope_types: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    salary_max: float | None = None
    score_min: float | None = None
    score_max: float | None = None
    posted_age_min_days: int | None = None
    posted_age_max_days: int | None = None
    fetched_age_min_days: int | None = None
    fetched_age_max_days: int | None = None
    first_seen_age_min_days: int | None = None
    first_seen_age_max_days: int | None = None
    last_seen_age_min_days: int | None = None
    last_seen_age_max_days: int | None = None
    follow_up_due_min_days: int | None = None
    follow_up_due_max_days: int | None = None
    application_limit_next_eligible_min_days: int | None = None
    application_limit_next_eligible_max_days: int | None = None
    has_salary: bool | None = None
    has_country: bool | None = None
    has_description: bool | None = None
    has_coordinates: bool | None = None
    has_linked_run: bool | None = None
    has_jd_refresh_state: bool | None = None
    has_application_limit_notice: bool | None = None

    def to_params(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Render the wire query-param dict, omitting unset filters."""
        params: dict[str, str] = {
            "limit": str(self.limit),
            "offset": str(self.offset),
        }
        _add_optional_params(params, _legacy_entries(self))
        _add_tuple_params(params, _facet_entries(self))
        _add_optional_params(params, _range_entries(self))
        _add_bool_params(params, _flag_entries(self))
        if self.hide_stale:
            # FastAPI bool params accept Python's lowercase serialization.
            params["hide_stale"] = str(self.hide_stale).lower()
        if self.hide_dismissed:
            params["hide_dismissed"] = str(self.hide_dismissed).lower()
        return params

_EXTRA_FACET_ENTRIES: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    (search_keys.KEY_STATES, "states"),

)

_EXTRA_FLAG_ENTRIES: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    (search_keys.KEY_INCLUDE_DESCRIPTIONS, "include_descriptions"),
    (search_keys.KEY_INCLUDE_UNKNOWN_COUNTRY, "include_unknown_country"),
    (search_keys.KEY_INCLUDE_DISMISSED, "include_dismissed"),
)


def _facet_entries(
    query: OpportunityListQuery,
) -> tuple[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]], ...]:
    """Build facet entries from shared FACET_KEYS + extras."""
    entries: list[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]] = []
    for key in FACET_KEYS:
        wire_key = $SECRET key)
        value = getattr(query, key)
        entries.append((wire_key, value))
    return tuple(entries)


def _range_entries(
    query: OpportunityListQuery,
) -> tuple[tuple[str, object | None], ...]:
    """Build range entries from shared RANGE_KEYS."""
    entries: list[tuple[str, object | None]] = []
    for key in RANGE_KEYS:
        wire_key = $SECRET key)
        value = getattr(query, key)
        entries.append((wire_key, value))
    return tuple(entries)


def _flag_entries(
    query: OpportunityListQuery,
) -> tuple[tuple[str, bool | None], ...]:
    """Build flag entries from shared FLAG_KEYS + extras."""
    entries: list[tuple[str, bool | None]] = []
    for wire_key, attr in _EXTRA_FLAG_ENTRIES:
        entries.append((wire_key, getattr(query, attr)))
    for key in FLAG_KEYS:
        wire_key = $SECRET key)
        value = getattr(query, key)
        entries.append((wire_key, value))
    return tuple(entries)


def _add_tuple_params(
    params: dict[str, str],
    entries: tuple[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]], ...],
) -> None:
    for key, values in entries:
        if values:
            params[key] = ",".join(values)


def _add_optional_params(
    params: dict[str, str],
    entries: tuple[tuple[str, object | None], ...],
) -> None:
    for key, value in entries:
        if value is not None:
            params[key] = str(value)


def _add_bool_params(
    params: dict[str, str],
    entries: tuple[tuple[str, bool | None], ...],
) -> None:
    for key, value in entries:
        if value is not None:
            params[key] = str(value).lower()

class _RecordingExecutor:
    def __init__(self, *, raise_on_submit: bool = False) -> None:
        self._raise_on_submit = raise_on_submit
        self.submitted: list[_SubmittedCall] = []

    def submit(
        self,
        task: object,
        miss_input: ReconcileMissInput,
    ) -> None:
        self.submitted.append(
            _SubmittedCall(
                task_name=getattr(task, "__name__", ""),
                hostname=miss_input.hostname,
                url=miss_input.url,
                unresolved_fields=tuple(miss_input.unresolved_fields),
                review_items=tuple(miss_input.review_items),
                match_by_field=miss_input.match_by_field,
                all_fields_by_id=miss_input.all_fields_by_id,
                learn_manifest_path=miss_input.learn_manifest_path,
                mapping_extension_path=miss_input.mapping_extension_path,
                uses_reconcile_lock=miss_input.reconcile_lock is _RECONCILE_LOCK,
            )
        )

            mapping_extension_path=_MAPPING_EXTENSION_PATH,
        )
    )

    return {PK_URL: "", HOSTNAME_KEY: "fallback.example.com"}

    case: _ScheduleCase,

) -> _ExecutorProjection:
    executor = _RecordingExecutor(raise_on_submit=raise_on_submit)

        unresolved_fields=[_FIELD] if case.has_unresolved_field else [],
        review_items=[as_json_object(_REVIEW_ITEM)] if case.has_review_item else [],
        intent_matches=[as_json_object(_INTENT_MATCH)],

"""Revision-safe browser verification binding at the projection boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

from src.agui.types import (
    FieldDecisionSnapshotEvent,
    FieldToolCalledEvent,
    FieldVerifiedEvent,
)
from src.key_catalog import SV_PASSED
from src.tui.projections.store import ProjectionStore
from src.types.types import JsonValue

_TS = "2026-05-11T12:00:00+00:00"
_CONTROL_ID = "email"


def _seed_proposal(
    store: ProjectionStore,
    value: JsonValue,
    sequence_number: int,
) -> None:
    store.apply(
        FieldDecisionSnapshotEvent(
            control_id=_CONTROL_ID,
            proposed_value=value,
            source="ai_plan",
            sequence_number=sequence_number,
            timestamp=_TS,
        )
    )


def _start_verification(
    store: ProjectionStore,
    verification_id: str | None,
    expected_value: str | None,
    sequence_number: int = 0,
) -> None:
    store.apply(
        FieldToolCalledEvent(
            control_id=_CONTROL_ID,
            tool_name="verify_field",
            status="phase",
            verification_id=verification_id,
            expected_value=expected_value,
            sequence_number=sequence_number,
            timestamp=_TS,
        )
    )


def _verify(
    store: ProjectionStore,
    verification_id: str | None,
    current_value: str = "a",
    expected_value: str = "a",
    sequence_number: int = 0,
) -> None:
    store.apply(
        FieldVerifiedEvent(
            control_id=_CONTROL_ID,
            verification_state=SV_PASSED,
            current_value=current_value,
            expected_value=expected_value,
            verification_id=verification_id,
            sequence_number=sequence_number,
            timestamp=_TS,
        )
    )


def _verification_transitions(store: ProjectionStore) -> list[object]:
    return [
        transition
        for transition in store.fields[_CONTROL_ID].transitions
        if transition.kind == "verification"
    ]


def test_bound_result_marks_current_revision_verified() -> None:
    store = ProjectionStore()
    _seed_proposal(store, "a", 1)

    _start_verification(store, "V1", "a")
    assert store.fields[_CONTROL_ID].pending_verification_id == "V1"

    _verify(store, "V1", sequence_number=3)

    fp = store.fields[_CONTROL_ID]
    assert fp.verification_revision == fp.proposal_revision == 1
    assert fp.applied_revision == 1
    assert fp.pending_verification_id is None
    assert [(t.proposal_revision, t.outcome) for t in _verification_transitions(store)] == [
        (1, SV_PASSED)
    ]
    counts = store.run.counts
    assert counts.current_verified_fields == 1
    assert counts.current_applied_fields == 1


def test_start_binding_requires_expected_value_match() -> None:
    store = ProjectionStore()
    _seed_proposal(store, "a", 1)

    _start_verification(store, "V1", "different")
    assert store.fields[_CONTROL_ID].pending_verification_id is None

    _verify(store, "V1", sequence_number=3)

    fp = store.fields[_CONTROL_ID]
    assert fp.verification_revision is None
    assert store.run.counts.current_verified_fields == 0
    assert [t.proposal_revision for t in _verification_transitions(store)] == [0]


def test_delayed_result_after_new_proposal_stays_historical() -> None:
    store = ProjectionStore()
    _seed_proposal(store, "a", 1)
    _start_verification(store, "V1", "a")
    _seed_proposal(store, "b", 2)

    _verify(store, "V1", sequence_number=4)

    fp = store.fields[_CONTROL_ID]
    assert fp.proposal_revision == 2
    assert fp.verification_revision is None
    assert fp.applied_revision is None
    assert store.run.counts.current_verified_fields == 0
    transitions = _verification_transitions(store)
    assert [(t.proposal_revision, t.outcome) for t in transitions] == [(0, SV_PASSED)]
    assert transitions[0].reason == "uncorrelated: no matching binding"


def test_result_without_identity_does_not_verify_proposed_revision() -> None:
    store = ProjectionStore()
    _seed_proposal(store, "a", 1)

    _verify(store, None, sequence_number=2)

    fp = store.fields[_CONTROL_ID]
    assert fp.verification_revision is None
    assert store.run.counts.filled_fields == 0
    transitions = _verification_transitions(store)
    assert [(t.proposal_revision, t.outcome) for t in transitions] == [(0, SV_PASSED)]
    assert transitions[0].reason == "uncorrelated: no matching binding"


def test_readback_without_identity_verifies_revision_zero() -> None:
    store = ProjectionStore()

    _verify(store, None, sequence_number=1)

    fp = store.fields[_CONTROL_ID]
    assert fp.proposal_revision == 0
    assert fp.verification_revision == 0
    assert fp.applied_revision == 0
    assert fp.status == "filled"
    transitions = _verification_transitions(store)
    assert transitions[0].reason == "readback: no verification identity"


def test_redelivered_readback_counts_once() -> None:
    store = ProjectionStore()

    _verify(store, None, sequence_number=1)
    _verify(store, None, sequence_number=1)

"""Reconcile invocation lifecycle events into bounded field and run rows."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from src.agui import FieldToolCalledEvent
from src.tui.projections.agent_trace_model import TRACE_TOOL_CALL, AgentTraceEntry
from src.tui.projections.constants import MAX_TOOL_CALLS
from src.tui.projections.models.field import ToolCallRecord

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from src.tui.projections.store import ProjectionStore

_REOPENABLE_STATUSES: frozenset[str] = frozenset(("", "running", "requested"))
"""Statuses a late ``running`` event may still touch; terminal rows never reopen."""


def _reopens_terminal(previous_status: str, next_status: str) -> bool:
    """True when a late start would reopen an already-terminal row."""
    return previous_status not in _REOPENABLE_STATUSES and next_status == "running"


def _upsert(rows: list[ToolCallRecord], row: ToolCallRecord, limit: int) -> None:
    """Upsert one field-scoped record by call id, bounded at ``limit`` rows."""
    if row.tool_call_id:
        for index, previous in enumerate(rows):
            if previous.tool_call_id == row.tool_call_id:
                if _reopens_terminal(previous.status, row.status):
                    return
                rows[index] = row
                return
    if len(rows) < limit:
        rows.append(row)


def update_tool_rows(
    store: ProjectionStore, event: FieldToolCalledEvent, ts: str
) -> None:
    """Upsert correlated calls; unique arrival records for archives without IDs.

    Received arguments, reason, and result text are retained in full: the
    record keeps everything, presentation abbreviates.
    """
    if event.status == "phase":
        return  # pure phase markers are never queued or running tool calls
    record = ToolCallRecord(
        tool_name=event.tool_name or "",
        success=event.success,
        duration_ms=event.duration_ms,
        result_summary=event.result_summary or "",
        tool_call_id=event.tool_call_id or "",
        source=event.source or "",
        status=event.status or "",
        arguments_preview=event.arguments_preview or "",
        reason=event.reason or "",
        attempt=event.attempt,
    )
    if event.control_id:
        _upsert(
            store.get_or_create_field(event.control_id).tool_calls,
            record,
            MAX_TOOL_CALLS,
        )
    previous = (
        store.agent_trace.entries_by_id.get(record.tool_call_id)
        if record.tool_call_id
        else None
    )
    if previous is not None and _reopens_terminal(previous.status, record.status):
        return
    store.agent_trace.upsert(
        AgentTraceEntry(
            kind=TRACE_TOOL_CALL,
            control_id=event.control_id or "",
            tool_name=record.tool_name,
            success=record.success,
            duration_ms=record.duration_ms,
            result_summary=record.result_summary,
            timestamp_utc=ts,
            tool_call_id=record.tool_call_id,
            entry_id=record.tool_call_id,
            source=record.source,
            status=record.status,
            arguments_preview=record.arguments_preview,
            reason=record.reason,
            attempt=record.attempt,
        )
    )

"""Request context resolution for agent-stream runs."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import HTTPException, Request
from langchain_core.language_models import BaseChatModel

from cloud.routers.agent_stream.deps import agent_stream_router_module
from cloud.routers.agent_stream.models import (
    AgentStreamRequest,
    ResolvedStreamIds,
    ResolvedStreamModels,
    StreamRunContext,
)
from cloud.services.agent_runner_support.profile_markers import (
    log_elided_profile_fields,
    scan_profile_markers,
)
from cloud.services.checkpointer import InterruptManager, get_thread_id
from cloud.services.event_buffer import EventBuffer, RunSummary
from cloud.services.opportunity import authoritative_planner_job_payload_for_run
from cloud.services.opportunity.container import get_optional_opportunity_dependencies
from src.agui import PlannerToAGUIAdapter
from src.autopilot.graph.run_summary import SummaryModelProtocol
from src.key_catalog import PK_RUN_ID
from src.logging import get_logger
from src.opportunities import ListFilters
from src.opportunities.index.canonicalize import canonicalize_url
from src.types.payload import normalize_profile_payload
from src.types.typed import JsonObject
from src.types.types import JSON_MODE

logger = get_logger(__name__)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from cloud.services.agent_runner import TerminalRunObserver


def latest_sequence_from_summaries(
    summaries: list[RunSummary],
    run_id: str,
) -> int | None:
    for summary in summaries:
        if summary.run_id == run_id:
            return summary.latest_sequence
    return None


def extract_last_event_id(request: Request) -> tuple[bool, int]:
    """Parse Last-Event-ID header into (has_id, sequence) tuple."""
    raw = request.headers.get("Last-Event-ID") or request.headers.get("last-event-id")
    if raw is not None and raw.isdigit():
        sequence = int(raw)
        logger.debug(
            "Agent stream Last-Event-ID parsed",
            last_event_id_present=True,
            accepted=True,
            sequence=sequence,
        )
        return True, sequence
    logger.debug(
        "Agent stream Last-Event-ID parsed",
        last_event_id_present=raw is not None,
        accepted=False,
        sequence=-1,
    )
    return False, -1


def build_stream_payload(body: AgentStreamRequest, ids: JsonObject) -> JsonObject:
    """Normalize the request body into a planner-ready payload."""
    payload = normalize_profile_payload(
        cast(JsonObject, body.model_dump(mode=JSON_MODE, exclude_none=True))
    )
    payload.update(ids)
    payload["stream_status"] = True
    run_id = cast(str | None, ids.get(PK_RUN_ID))
    payload.update(authoritative_planner_job_payload_for_run(run_id))
    return payload


def request_has_target(body: AgentStreamRequest) -> bool:
    """Return True when a stream request includes enough target context."""
    return bool(body.url or body.hostname)


def enforce_stream_target_or_known_run(
    body: AgentStreamRequest,
    run_id: str,
    event_buffer: EventBuffer,
) -> bool:
    """Validate that new streams include a target while known-run attach may not."""
    if request_has_target(body):
        return False
    if event_buffer.has_run(run_id):
        return True
    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=422,
        detail="At least one of 'url' or 'hostname' must be provided",
    )


def resolve_stream_ids(
    body: AgentStreamRequest,
    interrupt_manager: InterruptManager,
) -> ResolvedStreamIds:
    plan_id = (
        body.plan_id
        or body.request_id
        or _active_handoff_run_for_url(body)
        or f"plan-{uuid4().hex}"
    )
    request_id = body.request_id or plan_id
    trace_id = body.trace_id or request_id
    run_id = plan_id
    thread_id = (
        body.thread_id or get_thread_id(interrupt_manager, run_id) or f"thread-{run_id}"
    )
    return ResolvedStreamIds(
        request_id=request_id,
        plan_id=plan_id,
        trace_id=trace_id,
        run_id=run_id,
        thread_id=thread_id,
    )


def _active_handoff_run_for_url(body: AgentStreamRequest) -> str | None:
    if body.plan_id or body.request_id or not body.url:
        return None
    deps = get_optional_opportunity_dependencies()
    if deps is None:
        return None
    target_url = canonicalize_url(body.url)
    matches = (
        handoff.run_id
        for opportunity in deps.index.list(ListFilters())
        if canonicalize_url(opportunity.apply_url) == target_url
        for handoff in (deps.handoff_store.get_latest_for_opportunity(opportunity.id),)
        if handoff is not None and handoff.terminal_state is None
    )
    return next(matches, None)


def resolve_stream_models(payload: JsonObject) -> ResolvedStreamModels:
    facade = agent_stream_router_module()
    get_judge = cast(Callable[[], BaseChatModel], facade.get_judge_model)
    get_summary = cast(
        Callable[[], SummaryModelProtocol],
        facade.get_summary_model,
    )
    llm_client = get_judge()
    summary_llm_client = get_summary()
    return ResolvedStreamModels(
        llm_client=llm_client,
        summary_llm_client=summary_llm_client,
    )


def _scan_for_elided_fields(payload: JsonObject, run_id: str) -> None:
    """Detect SummaryMarker dicts in profile_data and log telemetry."""
    profile_data = payload.get("profile_data")
    if not isinstance(profile_data, dict):
        return
    scan = scan_profile_markers(profile_data)
    log_elided_profile_fields(scan, run_id=run_id)


def resolve_terminal_observer() -> TerminalRunObserver | None:
    """Build the optional cross-subsystem terminal observer for this run."""
    deps = get_optional_opportunity_dependencies()
    if deps is None:
        return None
    return deps.terminal_observer


def resolve_stream_context(
    body: AgentStreamRequest,
    request: Request,
    interrupt_manager: InterruptManager,
    event_buffer: EventBuffer,
) -> StreamRunContext:
    """Extract and resolve all identifiers from the incoming request."""
    ids = resolve_stream_ids(body, interrupt_manager)
    reattach_only = enforce_stream_target_or_known_run(
        body,
        ids.run_id,
        event_buffer,
    )
    payload = build_stream_payload(body, ids.as_payload())
    _scan_for_elided_fields(payload, ids.run_id)
    has_last_event_id, last_sequence = extract_last_event_id(request)
    models = resolve_stream_models(payload)
    logger.debug(
        "Resolved agent stream context",
        request_id=ids.request_id,
        plan_id=ids.plan_id,
        run_id=ids.run_id,
        thread_id=ids.thread_id,
        control_count=len(body.controls),
        resumed=has_last_event_id,
        last_sequence=last_sequence,
        llm_judge_enabled=models.llm_client is not None,
        summary_model_enabled=models.summary_llm_client is not None,
    )
    return StreamRunContext(
        request_id=ids.request_id,
        plan_id=ids.plan_id,
        trace_id=ids.trace_id,
        run_id=ids.run_id,
        thread_id=ids.thread_id,
        payload=payload,
        adapter=PlannerToAGUIAdapter(
            request_id=ids.request_id,
            plan_id=ids.plan_id,
            trace_id=ids.trace_id,
        ),
        llm_client=models.llm_client,
        summary_llm_client=models.summary_llm_client,
        interrupt_manager=interrupt_manager,
        event_buffer=event_buffer,
        has_last_event_id=has_last_event_id,
        last_sequence=last_sequence,
        reattach_only=reattach_only,
        terminal_observer=resolve_terminal_observer(),
    )


__all__ = (
    "build_stream_payload",
    "enforce_stream_target_or_known_run",
    "extract_last_event_id",
    "latest_sequence_from_summaries",
    "request_has_target",
    "resolve_stream_context",
    "resolve_stream_ids",
    "resolve_stream_models",
    "resolve_terminal_observer",
)

+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from contextlib import AbstractContextManager, nullcontext
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Final, Protocol, cast
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import src.key_catalog
+from cloud.services.agent_runner_support.payload import PayloadFieldView, field_control_id
+from cloud.services.agent_runner_support.postprocess.models import PostProcessOutcome
+from src.autopilot.tracing import FieldTrace
+from src.logging import get_logger
+from src.types.typed import JsonObject
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+_LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY = "LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY"
+_DATASET_EXPORT_FLAG = "LANGFUSE_DATASET_EXPORT"
+_DATASET_NAME = "job-hunter-failure-candidates"
+_TRACE_ID_RE: Final[re.Pattern[str]] = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{32}$")
+_MAX_PROPAGATED_VALUE_LEN = 200
+_MAX_FIELD_OBSERVATIONS = 100
+_MAX_LABEL_LEN = 160
+_MAX_REASON_LEN = 240
+
+_RunIds = tuple[str, str, str, str, str]
+
+
+class _Flushable(Protocol):
+    def flush(self) -> object: ...
+
+
+class _ObservationFactory(Protocol):
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        name: str,
+        as_type: str,
+        input: JsonObject | None = None,
+        output: JsonObject | None = None,
+        metadata: JsonObject | None = None,
+    ) -> AbstractContextManager[object]: ...
+
+
+class _ScoreCreator(Protocol):
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        name: str,
+        value: int | float | bool,
+        trace_id: str | None = None,
+        comment: str | None = None,
+        metadata: JsonObject | None = None,
+    ) -> object: ...
+
+
+class _DatasetItemCreator(Protocol):
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        dataset_name: str,
+        input: JsonObject | None = None,
+        expected_output: JsonObject | None = None,
+        metadata: JsonObject | None = None,
+        source_trace_id: str | None = None,
+        id: str | None = None,
+        status: str | None = None,
+    ) -> object: ...
+
+
+class _TraceUrlGetter(Protocol):
+    def __call__(self, *, trace_id: str | None = None) -> str | None: ...
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _RunIdentity:
+    request_id: str
+    plan_id: str
+    app_trace_id: str
+    run_id: str
+    thread_id: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _FieldStats:
+    traces: tuple[FieldTrace, ...]
+    passed: int
+    failed: int
+    errored: int
+
+    @property
+    def attempted(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.traces)
+
+
+class LangfuseRunObserver:
+    """No-op-safe Langfuse observer for one agent-stream run."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        client: object | None,
+        identity: _RunIdentity,
+        payload: JsonObject,
+        trace_id: str | None,
+        trace_url: str | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._client = client
+        self._identity = identity
+        self._payload = payload
+        self._trace_id = trace_id
+        self._trace_url = trace_url
+        self._callback: object | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def trace_url(self) -> str | None:
+        return self._trace_url
+
+    def inject_callback(self, graph_config: dict[str, object]) -> object | None:
+        """Attach Langfuse LangChain callback to ``graph_config`` when enabled."""
+        if self._client is None:
+            return None
+        callback = _build_callback_handler(self._trace_context())
+        if callback is None:
+            return None
+        existing = graph_config.get("callbacks")
+        callbacks = list(cast("list[object]", existing)) if isinstance(existing, list) else []
+        callbacks.append(callback)
+        graph_config["callbacks"] = callbacks
+        self._callback = callback
+        return callback
+
+    def observe_graph_run(self) -> AbstractContextManager[object]:
+        """Return a root observation context for graph + postprocess work."""
+        if self._client is None:
+            return nullcontext()
+        self._propagate_trace_attributes()
+        factory = getattr(self._client, "start_as_current_observation", None)
+        if not callable(factory):
+            return nullcontext()
+        observation_factory = cast(_ObservationFactory, factory)
+        return observation_factory(
+            name="job-hunter.agent_stream",
+            as_type="span",
+            input=_run_input(self._payload),
+            metadata=_trace_metadata(self._identity, self._payload),
+        )
+
+    def record_completed_run(
+        self,
+        *,
+        result: Mapping[str, object],
+        outcome: PostProcessOutcome,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Emit postprocess scores, field observations, and optional dataset item."""
+        if self._client is None:
+            return
+        stats = _field_stats(result)
+        self._score_completed_run(result=result, outcome=outcome, stats=stats)
+        self._observe_fields(stats.traces)
+        self._export_dataset_candidate(result=result, outcome=outcome, stats=stats)
+
+    def flush(self) -> None:
+        _flush_if_present(self._callback)
+        _flush_if_present(self._client)
+
+    def _trace_context(self) -> dict[str, str] | None:
+        if self._trace_id is None:
+            return None
+        return {"trace_id": self._trace_id}
+
+    def _propagate_trace_attributes(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            from langfuse import propagate_attributes
+        except ImportError as exc:
+            logger.warning(
+                "Langfuse propagate_attributes unavailable",
+                run_id=self._identity.run_id,
+                exception_type=type(exc).__name__,
+            )
+            return
+        propagate_attributes(
+            session_id=_bounded(self._identity.run_id),
+            user_id=_local_operator_id(),
+            trace_name="job-hunter.agent_stream",
+            tags=["job-hunter", "agent-stream"],
+            metadata=_propagated_metadata(self._identity, self._payload),
+        )
+
+    def _score_completed_run(
+        self,
+        *,
+        result: Mapping[str, object],
+        outcome: PostProcessOutcome,
+        stats: _FieldStats,
+    ) -> None:
+        total_fields = _total_field_count(self._payload)
+        scores = _score_values(
+            result=result,
+            outcome=outcome,
+            stats=stats,
+            total_fields=total_fields,
+        )
+        creator_raw = getattr(self._client, "create_score", None)
+        if not callable(creator_raw):
+            return
+        creator = cast(_ScoreCreator, creator_raw)
+        metadata: JsonObject = {
+            "run_id": self._identity.run_id,
+            "request_id": self._identity.request_id,
+            "plan_id": self._identity.plan_id,
+        }
+        for name, value in scores.items():
+            try:
+                creator(
+                    name=name,
+                    value=value,
+                    trace_id=self._trace_id,
+                    metadata=metadata,
+                )
+            except Exception as exc:
+                logger.warning(
+                    "Langfuse score emission failed",
+                    run_id=self._identity.run_id,
+                    score_name=name,
+                    exception_type=type(exc).__name__,
+                )
+
+    def _observe_fields(self, traces: tuple[FieldTrace, ...]) -> None:
+        factory_raw = getattr(self._client, "start_as_current_observation", None)
+        if not callable(factory_raw):
+            return
+        factory = cast(_ObservationFactory, factory_raw)
+        for trace in traces[:_MAX_FIELD_OBSERVATIONS]:
+            metadata = _field_metadata(trace)
+            output = _field_output(trace)
+            try:
+                with factory(
+                    name=f"field.{trace.control_id}",
+                    as_type="span",
+                    input=metadata,
+                    output=output,
+                    metadata=metadata,
+                ):
+                    pass
+            except Exception as exc:
+                logger.warning(
+                    "Langfuse field observation failed",
+                    run_id=self._identity.run_id,
+                    control_id=trace.control_id,
+                    exception_type=type(exc).__name__,
+                )
+
+    def _export_dataset_candidate(
+        self,
+        *,
+        result: Mapping[str, object],
+        outcome: PostProcessOutcome,
+        stats: _FieldStats,
+    ) -> None:
+        if os.getenv(_DATASET_EXPORT_FLAG) != "1":
+            return
+        reasons = _failure_reasons(result=result, outcome=outcome, stats=stats)
+        if not reasons:
+            return
+        creator_raw = getattr(self._client, "create_dataset_item", None)
+        if not callable(creator_raw):
+            return
+        creator = cast(_DatasetItemCreator, creator_raw)
+        item_id = f"{self._identity.run_id}:failure-candidate"
+        try:
+            creator(
+                dataset_name=_DATASET_NAME,
+                id=item_id,
+                input=_dataset_input(self._payload, result),
+                expected_output={"status": "pending_manual_review"},
+                metadata={
+                    "run_id": self._identity.run_id,
+                    "failure_reasons": list(reasons),
+                    "langfuse_trace_url": self._trace_url,
+                },
+                source_trace_id=self._trace_id,
+                status="ACTIVE",
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            logger.warning(
+                "Langfuse dataset export failed",
+                run_id=self._identity.run_id,
+                exception_type=type(exc).__name__,
+            )
+
+
+def build_langfuse_run_observer(
+    *,
+    ids: _RunIds,
+    payload: JsonObject,
+) -> LangfuseRunObserver:
+    """Build a Langfuse observer, or a no-op observer when disabled."""
+    identity = _identity_from_ids(ids)
+    if not os.getenv(_LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY):
+        return LangfuseRunObserver(
+            client=None,
+            identity=identity,
+            payload=payload,
+            trace_id=None,
+            trace_url=None,
+        )
+    client = _build_client()
+    trace_id = _langfuse_trace_id(identity.app_trace_id, client)
+    trace_url = _trace_url(client, trace_id)
+    return LangfuseRunObserver(
+        client=client,
+        identity=identity,
+        payload=payload,
+        trace_id=trace_id,
+        trace_url=trace_url,
+    )
+
+
+def _build_client() -> object | None:
+    try:
+        from langfuse import Langfuse
+    except ImportError as exc:
+        logger.warning("Langfuse SDK import failed", exception_type=type(exc).__name__)
+        return None
+    try:
+        return Langfuse()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Langfuse client creation failed", exception_type=type(exc).__name__)
+        return None
+
+
+def _build_callback_handler(trace_context: dict[str, str] | None) -> object | None:
+    try:
+        from langfuse.langchain import CallbackHandler
+    except ImportError as exc:
+        logger.warning(
+            "Langfuse LangChain callback import failed",
+            exception_type=type(exc).__name__,
+        )
+        return None
+    return CallbackHandler(trace_context=trace_context)
+
+
+def _identity_from_ids(ids: _RunIds) -> _RunIdentity:
+    request_id, plan_id, app_trace_id, run_id, thread_id = ids
+    return _RunIdentity(
+        request_id=request_id,
+        plan_id=plan_id,
+        app_trace_id=app_trace_id,
+        run_id=run_id,
+        thread_id=thread_id,
+    )
+
+
+def _langfuse_trace_id(app_trace_id: str, client: object | None) -> str:
+    normalized = app_trace_id.lower()
+    if _TRACE_ID_RE.fullmatch(normalized):
+        return normalized
+    generator = getattr(client, "create_trace_id", None)
+    if callable(generator):
+        try:
+            generated = generator()
+        except Exception as exc:
+            logger.warning(
+                "Langfuse trace id generation failed",
+                exception_type=type(exc).__name__,
+            )
+        else:
+            if isinstance(generated, str) and _TRACE_ID_RE.fullmatch(generated):
+                return generated
+    return uuid4().hex
+
+
+def _trace_url(client: object | None, trace_id: str | None) -> str | None:
+    getter_raw = getattr(client, "get_trace_url", None)
+    if not callable(getter_raw):
+        return None
+    getter = cast(_TraceUrlGetter, getter_raw)
+    try:
+        return getter(trace_id=trace_id)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Langfuse trace URL lookup failed", exception_type=type(exc).__name__)
+        return None
+
+
+def _run_input(payload: JsonObject) -> JsonObject:
+    fields = PayloadFieldView.from_payload(payload).fields
+    return {
+        "url_present": isinstance(payload.get(src.key_catalog.PK_URL), str),
+        "hostname": _optional_string(payload.get(src.key_catalog.PK_HOSTNAME)),
+        "platform": _optional_string(payload.get(src.key_catalog.PK_PLATFORM)),
+        "field_count": len(fields),
+        "required_field_count": _required_count(fields),
+    }
+
+
+def _trace_metadata(identity: _RunIdentity, payload: JsonObject) -> JsonObject:
+    metadata: JsonObject = dict(_run_input(payload))
+    metadata.update(
+        {
+            "request_id": identity.request_id,
+            "plan_id": identity.plan_id,
+            "run_id": identity.run_id,
+            "thread_id": identity.thread_id,
+            "app_trace_id": identity.app_trace_id,
+            "enable_llm_judge": _bool_env("BRIDGE_FORCE_DISABLE_LLM_JUDGE") is not True,
+        }
+    )
+    return metadata
+
+
+def _propagated_metadata(identity: _RunIdentity, payload: JsonObject) -> dict[str, str]:
+    raw = _trace_metadata(identity, payload)
+    return {key: _bounded(str(value)) for key, value in raw.items() if value is not None}
+
+
+def _field_stats(result: Mapping[str, object]) -> _FieldStats:
+    traces = _field_traces(result)
+    passed = sum(1 for trace in traces if trace.verification_passed is True)
+    failed = sum(1 for trace in traces if trace.verification_passed is False)
+    errored = sum(
+        1
+        for trace in traces
+        if trace.error is not None or any(not call.success for call in trace.tool_calls)
+    )
+    return _FieldStats(traces=traces, passed=passed, failed=failed, errored=errored)
+
+
+def _field_traces(result: Mapping[str, object]) -> tuple[FieldTrace, ...]:
+    raw = result.get("field_traces")
+    if not isinstance(raw, list):
+        form_trace = result.get("form_run_trace")
+        if isinstance(form_trace, Mapping):
+            raw = form_trace.get("fields")
+    if not isinstance(raw, list):
+        return ()
+    traces: list[FieldTrace] = []
+    for item in raw:
+        trace = FieldTrace.from_mapping(item)
+        if trace is not None and trace.execution_attempted:
+            traces.append(trace)
+    return tuple(traces)
+
+
+def _score_values(
+    *,
+    result: Mapping[str, object],
+    outcome: PostProcessOutcome,
+    stats: _FieldStats,
+    total_fields: int,
+) -> dict[str, int | float | bool]:
+    denominator = max(total_fields, stats.attempted, 1)
+    metadata_completeness = _metadata_completeness(outcome.job_metadata_result)
+    values: dict[str, int | float | bool] = {
+        "jd_acquisition_success": _has_job_description(result),
+        "metadata_completeness": metadata_completeness,
+        "fill_rate": stats.passed / denominator,
+        "actionable_fill_rate": len(outcome.final_actions()) / denominator,
+        "verification_pass_rate": stats.passed / max(stats.attempted, 1),
+        "review_burden": len(outcome.review_items) / denominator,
+        "executor_error_count": stats.errored,
+        "required_field_success": _required_field_success(outcome.final_actions(), total_fields),
+        "operator_intervention_required": bool(outcome.review_items),
+    }
+    if stats.failed:
+        values["false_positive_review_count"] = 0
+    return values
+
+
+def _metadata_completeness(raw_metadata: object) -> float:
+    if not isinstance(raw_metadata, Mapping):
+        return 0.0
+    keys = (src.key_catalog.PK_TITLE, src.key_catalog.PK_COMPANY, "location", "location_kind")
+    present = sum(1 for key in keys if bool(raw_metadata.get(key)))
+    return present / len(keys)
+
+
+def _has_job_description(result: Mapping[str, object]) -> bool:
+    candidate = result.get("job_description") or result.get("jd_text")
+    return isinstance(candidate, str) and bool(candidate.strip())
+
+
+def _required_field_success(actions: list[JsonObject], total_fields: int) -> bool:
+    return total_fields > 0 and len(actions) >= total_fields
+
+
+def _field_metadata(trace: FieldTrace) -> JsonObject:
+    return {
+        "control_id": trace.control_id,
+        "label": _bounded(trace.question_text or "", _MAX_LABEL_LEN),
+        "widget_kind": trace.widget_kind,
+        "required": None,
+        "intent_id": trace.intent_id,
+        "decision_source": trace.decision_source,
+        "confidence": trace.confidence_score,
+        "tool_call_count": len(trace.tool_calls),
+        "tool_success_count": sum(1 for call in trace.tool_calls if call.success),
+    }
+
+
+def _field_output(trace: FieldTrace) -> JsonObject:
+    return {
+        "verification_passed": trace.verification_passed,
+        "verification_result": trace.verification_result,
+        "mismatch_reason": _bounded(trace.mismatch_reason or "", _MAX_REASON_LEN),
+        "error": _bounded(trace.error or "", _MAX_REASON_LEN),
+    }
+
+
+def _failure_reasons(
+    *,
+    result: Mapping[str, object],
+    outcome: PostProcessOutcome,
+    stats: _FieldStats,
+) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    metadata_source = _metadata_source(outcome.job_metadata_result)
+    if metadata_source == "NONE":
+        reasons.append("metadata_source_none")
+    if stats.failed:
+        reasons.append("verification_failed")
+    if stats.errored:
+        reasons.append("executor_error")
+    verdict = getattr(outcome.judge_result, "overall_verdict", None)
+    if verdict in {"review", "block"}:
+        reasons.append(f"judge_{verdict}")
+    if len(outcome.review_items) >= max(3, _total_field_count_from_result(result) // 2):
+        reasons.append("review_heavy")
+    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(reasons))
+
+
+def _metadata_source(raw_metadata: object) -> str | None:
+    if isinstance(raw_metadata, Mapping):
+        source = raw_metadata.get(src.key_catalog.PK_SOURCE)
+        if isinstance(source, str):
+            return source
+    return None
+
+
+def _dataset_input(payload: JsonObject, result: Mapping[str, object]) -> JsonObject:
+    fields = PayloadFieldView.from_payload(payload).fields
+    return {
+        "url_hash": _bounded(str(hash(_optional_string(payload.get(src.key_catalog.PK_URL)) or ""))),
+        "hostname": _optional_string(payload.get(src.key_catalog.PK_HOSTNAME)),
+        "platform": _optional_string(payload.get(src.key_catalog.PK_PLATFORM)),
+        "field_descriptors": [_field_descriptor(field) for field in fields[:_MAX_FIELD_OBSERVATIONS]],
+        "jd_snippet": _bounded(_job_description(result), 500),
+    }
+
+
+def _field_descriptor(field: JsonObject) -> JsonObject:
+    return {
+        "control_id": field_control_id(field),
+        "label": _bounded(str(field.get(src.key_catalog.PK_LABEL) or ""), _MAX_LABEL_LEN),
+        "widget_kind": _optional_string(field.get(src.key_catalog.PK_WIDGET_KIND)),
+        "required": field.get("required") if isinstance(field.get("required"), bool) else None,
+    }
+
+
+def _job_description(result: Mapping[str, object]) -> str:
+    candidate = result.get("job_description") or result.get("jd_text")
+    return candidate if isinstance(candidate, str) else ""
+
+
+def _total_field_count(payload: JsonObject) -> int:
+    return len(PayloadFieldView.from_payload(payload).fields)
+
+
+def _total_field_count_from_result(result: Mapping[str, object]) -> int:
+    fields = result.get("fields")
+    return len(fields) if isinstance(fields, list) else 0
+
+
+def _required_count(fields: tuple[JsonObject, ...]) -> int:
+    return sum(1 for field in fields if field.get("required") is True)
+
+
+def _optional_string(value: object) -> str | None:
+    return value if isinstance(value, str) else None
+
+
+def _bounded(value: str, limit: int = _MAX_PROPAGATED_VALUE_LEN) -> str:
+    return value[:limit]
+
+
+def _bool_env(name: str) -> bool | None:
+    value = os.getenv(name)
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    return value.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
+
+
+def _local_operator_id() -> str:
+    return _bounded(os.getenv("JOB_HUNTER_OPERATOR_ID", "local-operator"))
+
+
+def _flush_if_present(candidate: object | None) -> None:
+    if candidate is None:
+        return
+    flush_fn = getattr(candidate, "flush", None)
+    if not callable(flush_fn):
+        return
+    try:
+        cast(_Flushable, candidate).flush()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Langfuse flush failed", exception_type=type(exc).__name__)
+
+
+__all__ = ["LangfuseRunObserver", "build_langfuse_run_observer"]

"""Submit-button locator policy and discovery for final form submission."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Final, Mapping, Pattern

from playwright import async_api

from src.logging import get_logger

logger = get_logger(__name__)

_SUBMIT_ACTION_RE: Final[Pattern[str]] = re.compile(
    r"(submit|apply|send|finish|complete)", re.I
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SubmitLocatorPolicy:
    """Policy describing how to discover the final submit control on a form."""

    selectors: tuple[str, ...]
    role_names: tuple[Pattern[str], ...]
    ats_overrides: Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]]

    @classmethod
    def default(cls) -> SubmitLocatorPolicy:
        return cls(
            selectors=(
                'button[type="submit"]:visible',
                'input[type="submit"]:visible',
                'button:has-text("Submit Application"):visible',
                'button:has-text("Submit application"):visible',
                'button:has-text("Submit"):visible',
                'button:has-text("Apply"):visible',
                'button:has-text("Send application"):visible',
                'button:has-text("Complete"):visible',
                'button:has-text("Finish"):visible',
            ),
            role_names=(_SUBMIT_ACTION_RE,),
            ats_overrides={},
        )


def _platform_from_url(url: str) -> str | None:
    lowered = url.lower()
    if "workday.com" in lowered or "myworkdayjobs.com" in lowered:
        return "workday"
    if "greenhouse.io" in lowered:
        return "greenhouse"
    if "lever.co" in lowered:
        return "lever"
    if "ashby" in lowered:
        return "ashby"
    return None


async def find_unique_submit_selector(
    page: async_api.Page,
    policy: SubmitLocatorPolicy | None = None,
) -> str | None:
    """Return the first selector matching exactly one visible submit candidate, or None."""
    policy = policy or SubmitLocatorPolicy.default()

    # Prefer accessible role lookup when the page exposes get_by_role.
    try:
        locator = page.get_by_role("button", name=_SUBMIT_ACTION_RE)
        count = await locator.count()
        if count == 1:
            # Playwright role locators are not serializable to CSS; fall back to
            # the first matching CSS selector for the click call.
            pass
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - role lookup is best-effort
        pass

    url = page.url
    platform = _platform_from_url(url)
    if platform and platform in policy.ats_overrides:
        for selector in policy.ats_overrides[platform]:
            count = await page.locator(selector).count()
            if count == 1:
                return selector
            if count > 1:
                logger.warning(
                    "submit selector matches multiple candidates; trying next",
                    selector=selector,
                    count=count,
                )

    for selector in policy.selectors:
        count = await page.locator(selector).count()
        if count == 1:
            return selector
        if count > 1:
            logger.warning(
                "submit selector matches multiple candidates; trying next",
                selector=selector,
                count=count,
            )
    return None

"""Reading-region selection tests for the Run screen.

The Run middle region shows exactly one reading at a time: the live
Activity narrative, the field Inspector, the Tools history, or Debug
(diagnostics plus graph operations). Pressing the active mode's key
returns to Activity, so the live narrative is always one keystroke away.
"""

from typing import cast

from textual.pilot import Pilot

from src.tui.app import SupervisorApp
from src.tui.controller.demo import DemoSessionController
from src.tui.screens.run import RunScreen
from tests.tui.conftest import RecordingSessionController

_WIDTH: int = 140

    "#agent-trace",
    "#inspector-body",
    "#tool-history",
    "#timeline",
    "#graph-ops",
)


async def _press_and_capture(key: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, bool]]:
    """Press ``key`` and return the active reading plus region visibility."""
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=RecordingSessionController())
    async with app.run_test(size=(_WIDTH, _HEIGHT)) as pilot:
        await pilot.press(key)
        await pilot.pause()
        screen = cast(RunScreen, app.screen)
        display = {selector: app.screen.query_one(selector).display for selector in _READING_SELECTORS}
        return screen.reading_mode, display


async def _press_twice_and_capture(key: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, bool]]:
    """Press ``key`` twice and return the resulting reading state."""
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=RecordingSessionController())
    async with app.run_test(size=(_WIDTH, _HEIGHT)) as pilot:
        await pilot.press(key)
        await pilot.pause()
        await pilot.press(key)
        await pilot.pause()
        screen = cast(RunScreen, app.screen)
        display = {selector: app.screen.query_one(selector).display for selector in _READING_SELECTORS}
        return screen.reading_mode, display


async def _idle_visibility() -> dict[str, bool]:
    """Return reading-region visibility for a freshly mounted Run screen."""
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=DemoSessionController())
    async with app.run_test(size=(_WIDTH, _HEIGHT)) as pilot:
        await pilot.pause()
        return {
            selector: app.screen.query_one(selector).display
            for selector in _READING_SELECTORS
        }


async def test_default_reading_is_the_live_narrative() -> None:
    display = await _idle_visibility()

    assert display["#agent-trace"], "Activity is the default reading"
    for selector in ("#inspector-body", "#tool-history", "#timeline", "#graph-ops"):
        assert not display[selector], f"{selector} must stay hidden by default"


async def test_debug_stays_mounted_but_hidden_until_requested() -> None:
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=DemoSessionController())
    async with app.run_test(size=(_WIDTH, _HEIGHT)) as pilot:
        await pilot.pause()
        timeline = app.screen.query_one("#timeline")

        assert timeline.is_mounted, "diagnostics writers need the timeline mounted"
        assert not timeline.display, "the timeline stays hidden outside Debug"


async def test_inspector_key_shows_only_the_inspector_reading() -> None:
    mode, display = await _press_and_capture("i")

    assert mode == "inspector", f"i must activate the Inspector reading: {mode}"
    assert display["#inspector-body"], "the Inspector reading must be visible"
    assert not display["#agent-trace"], "Activity must yield to the Inspector reading"


async def test_tools_key_shows_the_tool_history_reading() -> None:
    mode, display = await _press_and_capture("t")

    assert mode == "tools", f"t must activate the Tools reading: {mode}"
    assert display["#tool-history"], "the Tools history must be visible"
    assert not display["#agent-trace"], "Activity must yield to the Tools reading"


async def test_debug_key_shows_diagnostics_and_graph_operations() -> None:
    mode, display = await _press_and_capture("d")

    assert mode == "debug", f"d must activate the Debug reading: {mode}"
    assert display["#timeline"], "Debug must reveal the diagnostics timeline"
    assert display["#graph-ops"], "Debug must reveal graph operations"


async def test_pressing_the_active_mode_key_returns_to_activity() -> None:
    mode, display = await _press_twice_and_capture("i")

    assert mode == "activity", "pressing the active mode key must return to Activity"
    assert display["#agent-trace"], "the live narrative must be visible again"
    assert not display["#inspector-body"], "the Inspector reading must close"


async def test_reading_mode_survives_projection_updates() -> None:
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=RecordingSessionController())
    async with app.run_test(size=(_WIDTH, _HEIGHT)) as pilot:
        await pilot.press("t")
        await pilot.pause()
        screen = cast(RunScreen, app.screen)
        screen.apply_projection(screen.projection)
        await pilot.pause()

        assert screen.reading_mode == "tools", (
            "a projection update must not silently change the operator's reading"
        )
        assert app.screen.query_one("#tool-history").display, (
            "the selected reading must remain visible across updates"
        )

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# /// script
+# requires-python = ">=3.11"
+# dependencies = []
+# ///
+# ─── How to run ───
+# python3 .omo/drafts/session-start-snapshot/lint_receipt.py record
+# python3 .omo/drafts/session-start-snapshot/lint_receipt.py check
+"""Record and verify Slopgate lint state from disposable detached worktrees."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import tomllib
+from enum import StrEnum
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final, NamedTuple, NoReturn, Sequence, TypeAlias, TypedDict
+
+JsonValue: TypeAlias = (
+    None | bool | int | float | str | list["JsonValue"] | dict[str, "JsonValue"]
+)
+DETAIL_HEADER: Final = re.compile(r"^    \[(?:NEW|KNOWN-DEBT)\] \S.*$")
+STABLE_ID_PREFIX: Final = "    stable-id: "
+RECEIPT_KEYS: Final = frozenset({"ids", "baseline_ids", "baselines_sha256"})
+ALLOWLIST_KEYS: Final = frozenset({"allowed_deletions"})
+PUBLIC_ARG_COUNT: Final = 2
+INTERNAL_ARG_COUNT: Final = 5
+MODE_ARG_INDEX: Final = 1
+INTERNAL_FLAG_START: Final = 2
+INTERNAL_FLAG_END: Final = 4
+STATE_ROOT_ARG_INDEX: Final = 4
+REPO_PARENT_DEPTH: Final = 3
+SHA256_HEX_LENGTH: Final = hashlib.sha256().digest_size * 2
+ERROR_OUTPUT_LIMIT: Final = 2**12
+WORKTREE_RUNNER: Final = r"""
+set -euo pipefail
+main_repo=$1; source_script=$2; state_root=$3; mode=$4; python_bin=$5
+temp_root=$(mktemp -d); snap=$temp_root/snap; added=0
+cleanup() {
+    local status=$1
+    trap - EXIT INT TERM
+    if [ "$added" -eq 1 ] && ! git -C "$main_repo" worktree remove --force "$snap"; then
+        printf 'failed to remove detached worktree: %s\n' "$snap" >&2; status=1
+    fi
+    if [ -d "$temp_root" ] && ! rm -rf "$temp_root"; then
+        printf 'failed to remove temporary directory: %s\n' "$temp_root" >&2; status=1
+    fi
+    exit "$status"
+}
+trap 'cleanup $?' EXIT
+trap 'cleanup 130' INT
+trap 'cleanup 143' TERM
+git -C "$main_repo" worktree add --detach "$snap" HEAD
+added=1
+cp "$source_script" "$snap/.lint_receipt.py"
+cd "$snap"
+if "$python_bin" "$snap/.lint_receipt.py" "$mode" --inside-worktree --state-root "$state_root"; then
+    child_status=0
+else
+    child_status=$?
+fi
+exit "$child_status"
+"""
+
+
+class Mode(StrEnum):
+    RECORD = "record"
+    CHECK = "check"
+
+
+class ReceiptPayload(TypedDict):
+    ids: list[str]
+    baseline_ids: list[str]
+    baselines_sha256: str
+
+
+class CliConfig(NamedTuple):
+    mode: Mode
+    inside_worktree: bool
+    state_root: Path | None
+
+
+class BaselineSnapshot(NamedTuple):
+    ids: frozenset[str]
+    sha256: str
+
+
+class CurrentSnapshot(NamedTuple):
+    ids: frozenset[str]
+    baseline: BaselineSnapshot
+    lint_exit_code: int
+
+
+class Receipt(NamedTuple):
+    ids: frozenset[str]
+    baseline_ids: frozenset[str]
+    baselines_sha256: str
+
+
+class Diff(NamedTuple):
+    additions: frozenset[str]
+    removals: frozenset[str]
+    unauthorized_removals: frozenset[str]
+
+
+class RunResult(NamedTuple):
+    exit_code: int
+    stdout: str
+    stderr: str
+
+
+class ReceiptError(RuntimeError):
+    """Invalid state, incomplete lint output, or unsafe execution."""
+
+
+def _fail(message: str) -> NoReturn:
+    raise ReceiptError(message)
+
+
+def _parse_mode(raw: str) -> Mode:
+    if raw == Mode.RECORD:
+        return Mode.RECORD
+    if raw == Mode.CHECK:
+        return Mode.CHECK
+    _fail(f"unknown mode {raw!r}; expected 'record' or 'check'")
+
+
+def _parse_cli(argv: Sequence[str]) -> CliConfig:
+    if len(argv) == PUBLIC_ARG_COUNT:
+        return CliConfig(_parse_mode(argv[MODE_ARG_INDEX]), False, None)
+    internal = (
+        len(argv) == INTERNAL_ARG_COUNT
+        and argv[INTERNAL_FLAG_START:INTERNAL_FLAG_END]
+        == ["--inside-worktree", "--state-root"]
+    )
+    if internal:
+        return CliConfig(
+            _parse_mode(argv[MODE_ARG_INDEX]),
+            True,
+            Path(argv[STATE_ROOT_ARG_INDEX]).resolve(),
+        )
+    _fail("usage: lint_receipt.py {record|check} [--inside-worktree --state-root PATH]")
+
+
+def _read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, JsonValue]:
+    try:
+        decoded: JsonValue = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
+        _fail(f"cannot read JSON object {path}: {error}")
+    if not isinstance(decoded, dict):
+        _fail(f"JSON root must be an object: {path}")
+    return decoded
+
+
+def _string_list(payload: dict[str, JsonValue], key: str, path: Path) -> list[str]:
+    value = payload.get(key)
+    if not isinstance(value, list) or not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in value):
+        _fail(f"{path}: {key!r} must be a list of strings")
+    strings = [item for item in value if isinstance(item, str)]
+    if len(strings) != len(set(strings)):
+        _fail(f"{path}: {key!r} contains duplicate IDs")
+    return strings
+
+
+def _baseline_path(repo_root: Path) -> Path:
+    relative = Path("baselines.json")
+    config_path = repo_root / "slopgate.toml"
+    if config_path.exists():
+        try:
+            config = tomllib.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        except (OSError, UnicodeError, tomllib.TOMLDecodeError) as error:
+            _fail(f"cannot parse {config_path}: {error}")
+        paths = config.get("paths")
+        if paths is not None:
+            if not isinstance(paths, dict):
+                _fail(f"{config_path}: [paths] must be a table")
+            configured = paths.get("baseline_path")
+            if not isinstance(configured, str) or not configured:
+                _fail(f"{config_path}: paths.baseline_path must be a nonempty string")
+            relative = Path(configured)
+    resolved = (relative if relative.is_absolute() else repo_root / relative).resolve()
+    try:
+        tracked_path = resolved.relative_to(repo_root)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ReceiptError(f"baseline must remain inside detached repo: {resolved}") from error
+    tracked = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", tracked_path.as_posix()],
+        cwd=repo_root,
+        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if tracked.returncode != 0:
+        _fail(f"baseline is not committed at HEAD: {tracked_path}")
+    return resolved
+
+
+def _capture_baseline(repo_root: Path) -> BaselineSnapshot:
+    path = _baseline_path(repo_root)
+    try:
+        content = path.read_bytes()
+    except OSError as error:
+        _fail(f"cannot read committed baseline {path}: {error}")
+    rules = _read_json(path).get("rules")
+    if not isinstance(rules, dict):
+        _fail(f"{path}: 'rules' must be an object")
+    ids: set[str] = set()
+    for rule_name, rule_ids in rules.items():
+        if not isinstance(rule_ids, list) or not all(
+            isinstance(item, str) for item in rule_ids
+        ):
+            _fail(f"{path}: rule {rule_name!r} must contain only string IDs")
+        ids.update(item for item in rule_ids if isinstance(item, str))
+    return BaselineSnapshot(frozenset(ids), hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest())
+
+
+def _extract_live_ids(output: str) -> frozenset[str]:
+    blocks: list[list[str]] = []
+    current: list[str] | None = None
+    lines = output.splitlines()
+    for line in lines:
+        if DETAIL_HEADER.fullmatch(line):
+            current = []
+            blocks.append(current)
+        elif current is not None:
+            current.append(line)

+        bytes.fromhex(provenance)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ReceiptError(f"{path}: invalid baselines_sha256") from error

+        frozenset(_string_list(payload, "ids", path)),
+        frozenset(_string_list(payload, "baseline_ids", path)),
+        provenance,
+    )

+
+def _allowed_deletions(path: Path) -> frozenset[str]:
+    payload = _read_json(path)
+    if frozenset(payload) != ALLOWLIST_KEYS:
+        _fail(f"{path}: expected exactly one 'allowed_deletions' key")

+def _diff(recorded: frozenset[str], current: frozenset[str], allowed: frozenset[str]) -> Diff:
+    removals = recorded - current

+def _render_diff(label: str, diff: Diff) -> str:
+    lines = [
+        f"{label}: additions={len(diff.additions)}, removals={len(diff.removals)}, "
+        f"unauthorized_removals={len(diff.unauthorized_removals)}"
+    ]
+    lines.extend(f"  + {stable_id}" for stable_id in sorted(diff.additions))
+    for stable_id in sorted(diff.removals):
+        marker = "allowed" if stable_id not in diff.unauthorized_removals else "UNAUTHORIZED"

+        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=False,

+def _record(current: CurrentSnapshot, receipt_path: Path) -> RunResult:
+    _atomic_write_receipt(

+            "baseline_ids": sorted(current.baseline.ids),
+            "baselines_sha256": current.baseline.sha256,
+        },
+    )

+        f"recorded receipt: live_ids={len(current.ids)}, "
+        f"baseline_ids={len(current.baseline.ids)}, lint_exit={current.lint_exit_code}\n"
+    )
+    return RunResult(0, summary, "")
+
+
+def _check(current: CurrentSnapshot, receipt_path: Path, allowlist_path: Path) -> RunResult:
+    receipt = _load_receipt(receipt_path)
+    allowed = _allowed_deletions(allowlist_path)
+    live = _diff(receipt.ids, current.ids, allowed)
+    baseline = _diff(receipt.baseline_ids, current.baseline.ids, allowed)
+    hash_status = (
+        "unchanged"
+        if receipt.baselines_sha256 == current.baseline.sha256
+        else "changed (provenance only)"
+    )
+    passed = not (
+        live.additions
+        or live.unauthorized_removals
+        or baseline.additions
+        or baseline.unauthorized_removals
+    )

+            _render_diff("live IDs", live),
+            _render_diff("committed baseline IDs", baseline),
+            f"baselines_sha256: {hash_status}",
+            "receipt check: PASS" if passed else "receipt check: FAIL",

+        check=False,
+    )
+    return RunResult(completed.returncode, "", "")

+
+def _main(argv: Sequence[str]) -> RunResult:
+    config = _parse_cli(argv)
+    return _run_inside(config) if config.inside_worktree else _run_detached(config)
+
